The Commission shall decide the same based on factors such as age & ramp rate, loss of efficiency, additional wear & tear of the unit, etc. Mark-up shall be communicated from time to time through a separate order._ 43. It is evident from the above that the Petitioner had already raised the question as to how payment for RRAS shall be adjusted if fixed and/or variable charges are modified at a later date and the Commission had clarified that the fixed or variable charge that is determined by the Commission (provisional or final) at the time of delivery of RRAS shall be used to calculate the payment for this service. No retroactive settlement shall be undertaken even if the fixed or variable charge is modified at a later date.
